summary: Two-step delegation helper (thiscall): enumerates vehicle names from the supplied config path, then loads nationality/career driver information for the current object using the enumerated vehicle index global dword_8AC38C. Both calls always execute; no guard path exists. Used by network, vehicle-load and driver-entry setup paths.

operations.description: Call VehicleNameEnumeration(a2) to enumerate vehicle names from the config path argument a2.
Call NationalityDriverInfoLoader(this, dword_8AC38C) passing the this object and the enumerated-vehicle index global dword_8AC38C to load nationality/career driver information.
Return the result of NationalityDriverInfoLoader to the caller.
